reason: B better addresses the high-temperature, dislocation-mediated creep regime and proposes an explicit interfacial design, controlled baseline, measurable creep response, stability boundaries, and falsification test. Its support is partly extrapolated from γ/γ′ interfaces and serrated grain boundaries rather than HEA multilayer interfaces, but A is less suitable because it focuses on room-to-moderate temperatures and assumes a monotonic interface-density benefit without isolating misfit from other thickness-dependent effects.
